name: Mesu Ochi Kyonyuuzuma wa Ore no Mono ~Make-gumi no Ore ga Kachi-gumi no Yuujin Kara Bijinzuma o Netoru Hanashi~
original_name: 牝堕ち巨乳妻は俺のモノ ～負け組の俺が勝ち組の友人から美人妻を寝取る話～
source:
Akitsu Shunsuke was once a happy guy with a decent job, a fiancee and a bright future ahead of him. But it all went to hell when his company got destroyed by a rival one. He lost his job, his fiancee and even his own future. 

Upon accepting a Class Reunion meeting, Shunsuke met 3 of his old friends, who used to bully him nonstop in the past. He also learned that one of them married the class's most beautiful girl - Saya. Not just that, the guy was working for the company that ruined his life. 

Now filled with hate and wanting revenge, Shunsuke set out to take everything from them, including their happiness and beautiful wives.
translation:
秋津俊介曾经是一个快乐的人，有一份体面的工作，有未婚妻，还有光明的未来。但当他的公司被竞争对手摧毁时，这一切都毁了。他失去了工作，失去了未婚妻，甚至失去了自己的未来。

在参加同学聚会时，俊介遇到了三个以前经常欺负他的老朋友。他还得知其中一位娶了班上最漂亮的女孩——沙耶。不仅如此，这个人正在为一家毁了他生活的公司工作。

俊介充满了仇恨，想要复仇，他开始夺走他们的一切，包括他们的幸福和美丽的妻子。
